newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bankruptcy, debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo.
newsitem.headline: Bankruptcy, debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo.

text.p: Filings for debt relief and bankruptcies in Sao Paulo fell 21.7 percent and 22 percent, respectively, in December 1996 compared to the annual average, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said in a statement.
Bankruptcy filings reached 3,038 and debt relief requests hit 57 in December, the statement said.

Serasa said December figures showed that Sao Paulo companies have been adjusting themselves to a low-inflation economy, noting that they benefitted from eased credit and falling domestic interest rates in 1996.
